title: Diósi-Penrose collapse with no free parameter

statements.text: In its natural parameter-free form, with the mass density of each nucleus taken at its physical size, Diósi-Penrose collapse makes charged particles diffuse and emit faint radiation at a calculable rate.
statements.scope: the simplest Diósi-Penrose model, as tested by Donadi et al.

standing.reason: The Gran Sasso measurement found no such radiation and bounds the effective size of the nuclear mass density about three orders of magnitude above earlier bounds, ruling out the parameter-free version.

sources.quote: He also provided a heuristic formula to compute the decay time of the superposition — similar to that suggested earlier by Lajos Diósi, hence the name Diósi-Penrose model.
